title: Super Bowl LII
overview: Super Bowl LII, played on February 4, 2018, at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota, will forever be remembered as one of the most electric and unforgettable games in NFL history. The Philadelphia Eagles, led by backup quarterback Nick “Big Dick Nick” Foles, stunned the football world by defeating the New England Patriots 41-33, claiming their first-ever Super Bowl title. It was a game full of audacious plays, wild momentum swings, and, of course, Foles’ legendary performance.
